# Awesome AI-Generated Games

> Playable games whose code was substantially written by AI: agents, copilots, or a person and a model vibe-coding together. Every entry opens in a browser and is playable in under ten seconds, with no download and no login wall.

AI can ship real games now, and they're scattered across personal domains, tweets and hosting platforms with no index. This list is that index.

**Submitting a game?** Open an issue using the [game submission form](../../issues/new?template=submit-game.yml), and see [CONTRIBUTING](CONTRIBUTING.md) first. Agents welcome; most entries here were built by one.

## Criteria

- **Playable in a browser, right now.** Stable URL, loads on desktop or phone, no account required to play.
- **Substantially AI-written.** The code came mostly from a model or agent, and a submission has to say which. Hand-polish is fine; hand-written games with AI art are not what this list is for.
- **A real game.** Win/lose states, score, or goals. Tech demos and generated art pieces belong elsewhere.

## Action & Arcade

- [Cloud Climb](https://summoned.games/games/cloud-climb) - Endless vertical jumper from dawn meadow to open orbit: springs, jetpacks, crumbling ledges, five biomes.
- [Lumen Drift](https://summoned.games/games/lumen-drift) - A moth drifting through gaps in neon signs; one touch lifts, gravity does the rest.
- [Popgun Alley](https://summoned.games/games/popgun-alley) - Comic-book lane shooter where breaking crates grows your gun teeth and choose-one gates force the call.
- [Skyline Stack](https://summoned.games/games/skyline-stack) - Stack a skyline block by block; miss the timing and the overhang gets sliced away.
- [Timber Tap](https://summoned.games/games/timber-tap) - Chop the tree from under yourself and never stand where the next branch drops.

## Multiplayer

- [Bannerhold](https://summoned.games/games/bannerhold) - Medieval castle RTS: build the economy, feed the peasants, raise walls, then siege your rival in 1v1 with an invite code.
- [Breach Point](https://summoned.games/games/breach-point) - Real 3D team shooter in the browser; drop in against competent bots and real players take over their slots live.
- [fly.pieter.com](https://fly.pieter.com) - The MMO flight sim Pieter Levels vibe-coded in hours; 89k players in its first week and famously past $50k a month.
- [Nitro Pitch](https://summoned.games/games/nitro-pitch) - Rocket-powered car soccer: two jet-boosted cars a side, one absurdly large ball, three minutes on the clock.
- [WW2 Dogfight Arena](https://fly.zullo.fun/) - Multiplayer prop-plane dogfighting with damage smoke, free-falls and explosions, written in roughly 500 prompts with no hand-edited code.

## Puzzle & Strategy

- [Nova Conquest](https://summoned.games/games/nova-conquest) - Drag fleets between worlds and take the galaxy from seven Elo-rated AI commanders.
- [Sumplete](https://sumplete.com) - The delete-numbers logic puzzle ChatGPT designed when asked to invent a new game; a human just hosted it.
- [Trailblaze](https://summoned.games/games/trailblaze) - A daily one-line path puzzle with a solver-verified fresh board every morning and a share-ready result card.

## Sandbox & Simulation

- [Cubelands](https://summoned.games/games/cubelands) - A voxel island to mine, build and light up at night, waiting exactly as you left it tomorrow.
- [Great Taxi Assignment](https://great-taxi-assignment.netlify.app/) - Ferry passengers through the sun-soaked streets of Vibe City to an 80s beat. Winner of the 2025 Vibe Coding Game Jam.
- [Vector Tango](https://www.vector-tango.com/) - Air traffic control in 3D: vector the inbound traffic through storms and shifting airspace without letting two of them meet.
